title: Reverse Subarray To Maximize Array Value
summary: Given an integer array nums, the value of the array is defined as the sum of the absolute differences between every pair of consecutive elements, i.e., the sum of |nums[i] - nums[i + 1]| for all 0 ≤ i < nums.length - 1 .
statement: Given an integer array nums, the value of the array is defined as the sum of the absolute differences between every pair of consecutive elements, i.e., the sum of |nums[i] - nums[i + 1]| for all 0 ≤ i < nums.length - 1 . You are permitted to reverse any subarray of nums exactly once. Your task is to determine the maximum possible value of the array after performing this operation.
constraints: nums has at least two integers.
Reverse one contiguous subarray; a length-one reversal is allowed.
Maximize the sum of absolute differences between adjacent values.
reference_solution:
def maximum_value_after_reverse(nums):
    base=sum(abs(a-b) for a,b in zip(nums,nums[1:]));gain=0
    for left,right in zip(nums,nums[1:]):
        gain=max(gain,abs(nums[0]-right)-abs(left-right),abs(nums[-1]-left)-abs(left-right))
    highest_low=max(min(left,right) for left,right in zip(nums,nums[1:]));lowest_high=min(max(left,right) for left,right in zip(nums,nums[1:]))
    gain=max(gain,2*(highest_low-lowest_high))
    return base+gain

hints: Only the edges crossing a reversed segment can change the total.
Handle prefix and suffix reversals by testing every original adjacent pair as the cut boundary.
For an internal reversal, the best gain is twice max(min endpoints) minus min(max endpoints).
Every reversal is prefix, suffix, or internal, and the formula captures exactly its two changed boundary edges.
editorial: The base adjacent-difference sum is unchanged inside a reversed segment. Prefix and suffix cases replace one boundary. For internal segments, algebra on the two boundary pairs reduces the maximum gain to twice the gap between the greatest lower endpoint and smallest upper endpoint. The oracle directly reverses every subarray on seeded small inputs.
